data.name: Iqra
data.gender_notes: Iqra is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ق-ر-أ (q-r-ʾ), 'to read, recite'. Iqraʾ is the imperative 'read!'. Its root is ق-ر-أ (q-r-ʾ). The first word revealed of the Qur'an (96:1). Iqra is a Arabic name meaning “Read; recite”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Iqra expresses “Read; recite”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ق-ر-أ (q-r-ʾ), 'to read, recite'. Iqraʾ is the imperative 'read!'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqra total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
